hypotheses.S0_native_model_responds_to_spelling_swa: The native disjoint spelling contrast moves toward the counterfactual dialect in at least 60% of examples in every fold and split.
hypotheses.S1_boundary_leading_mode_responds: The L9H8 leading write mode moves toward the counterfactual dialect in at least 60% of examples in every fold and split.
hypotheses.S2_boundary_edge_transmits_disjoint_styl: The finite L9H8 boundary-edge contribution to disjoint spelling logits moves correctly in at least 60% of examples in every fold and split.
hypotheses.S3_transport_is_boundary_specific: Median signed L9H8 boundary-edge shift is at least 1.5 times the matched non-boundary edge shift across fold/split cells.
hypotheses.S4_transport_is_head_specific: L9H8 boundary-edge win rate exceeds L9H7 by at least 0.05 in at least five of six fold/split cells.
hypotheses.S5_declared_contrast_beats_random: The declared disjoint spelling contrast exceeds the 95th percentile of balanced random target-token contrasts in at least five of six fold/split cells.
hypotheses.S6_counterfactual_dialect_transport_is_s: S0, S2, S4, and S5 all hold.
